name: @finapp/m25-operational-ai
description: M25 — Operational AI (Stage 5, GOVERNED MVP): AI assistance for Feedback (m12) and Case (m13) — summaries, sentiment, complaint/feedback classification, root-cause hints, suggested activities and routing/escalation recommendations — every one a human-reviewed SUGGESTION with confidence + citations. RECOMMENDS ONLY: it never closes, escalates, reassigns or resolves a controlled feedback/case item on its own (CLAUDE.md hard rules). It reuses the M24 governed AI gateway/registries + request->output->human-review pipeline BY CONTRACT (no second AI engine), references feedback/case subjects by OPAQUE id (reads no m12/m13 table), keeps restricted data on approved providers (m24 routing), audits every suggestion under the shared AI_ prefix, and owns NO second outbox and NO new event family (it reuses m24's ai.*_lifecycle events). Shares the m24 ai.* permission namespace.
